svg.text: Rectangle-Free 5-Coloring of the 27×27 Grid (Jason Davies / Zarankiewicz Frontier)
No axis-aligned 2×2 rectangle may have 4 same-colored corners · Conjectured threshold b₅(2) = 28 (26 ≤ b₅(2) ≤ 28; a 27×27 5-coloring settles the conjecture)
Actual Fixed Color-1 Template T₁ (147 cells, PG(2,5) ∖ 4×4)
Decoded from cnf-orig/02-open.cnf.xz: 0 monochromatic rectangles, row/col sums ∈ {5, 6}
02-open.cnf pinned host rows 0, 1, 2 → T₂ src rows 15, 0, 2
Partitioning 27² = 729 cells via 3 PG(2,5) templates + 2 free colors
Color 2 — Movable T₂ = R₂ T₁ C₂ᵀ
27×27 row & col bijections R₂, C₂; disjoint from T₁ (21,609 bin cls).
Color 3 — Movable T₃ = R₃ T₃ C₃ᵀ
582 non-T₁ cells × 4 color vars; 2 × 48,108 4-clauses + 22 row-0 SBP cls.
